edition: JIS G 3192 hot-rolled H-sections (wide, medium, narrow series) as tabulated in the JFE Steel shapes handbook
source: Published tables (see 'sources' and skyframe/docs/SECTION_SOURCES.md). J, Cw and shear areas are computed exactly from the published dimensions (listed in 'computed').

sources.JFE: JFE H-shape section property table (JIS G 3192 sizes) as transcribed in z-ichinohe/jfe_binran_csv @7f4e0d1 (none stated), 5. 断面性能表/5-1. H形鋼.csv

conventions: local 3 = major axis, 2 = minor; d along local 2.  As2 = d*tw, As3 = 5/3*bf*tf.  x0 = y0 = 0 (doubly symmetric). jis_note '*' = sizes marked in the handbook (outside the standard JIS series).
